parameters.name: agentIds

parameters.name: departmentId

post.description: Moves the specified tickets to the Recycle Bin. Note: Deleted tickets remain in the Recycle Bin for 60 days, during which they can be restored. After this period, they are permanently deleted.

get.description: Retrieves tickets that are followed by agents, with pagination support.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: Key that returns additional information related to a ticket. Values allowed are: contacts, products, and assignee. All three values can be passed by separating them with a comma in the API request.

parameters.name: follower
parameters.description: ID of the agent who is a follower of the ticket. Possible value: A valid agentId

parameters.name: departmentId
parameters.description: ID of the department from which tickets must be fetched

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of tickets to fetch

parameters.name: sharedDepartmentId
parameters.description: Fetches only the tickets shared from @departmentId@ to @sharedDepartmentId@. If @departmentId@ is not provided, fetches all the tickets shared to @sharedDepartmentId@. @sharedDepartmentId@ is given precedence only when @isShared@ is @false@/not given.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Index number, starting from which the tickets must be listed

parameters.name: assignee
parameters.description: ID of the assignee. Possible values: Unassigned: Tickets not assigned to any agent. {assigneeId}: Valid assigneeId Note: Multiple values can be provided by separating them with commas

parameters.name: receivedInDays
parameters.description: Time period (in days) for fetching tickets based on customerResponseTime. Possible values: 15, 30, 90 days

parameters.name: isShared
parameters.description: Retrieves tickets after validating permissions against departmentId (true) or sharedDepartmentId (false). Possible values: true : Retrieves tickets that are shared with other departments, with permission checks performed on departmentId When both departmentId and sharedDepartmentId are provided, tickets that are shared from departmentId to sharedDepartmentId are returned. Permission checks are performed on departmentId. When only departmentId is provided and sharedDepartmentId is not, tickets that are shared from departmentId to any other department are returned. Permission checks are performed on departmentId. When both departmentId and sharedDepartmentId are not provided, shared tickets from all permitted departments are returned. Permission checks are performed on each permitted department.false : Retrieves tickets that are shared with the specified sharedDepartmentId, with permission checks performed on sharedDepartmentId

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Status of the ticket Note: Multiple values can be provided by separating them with commas

parameters.name: commenter
parameters.description: Filter by commenters of the ticket. Values allowed : a valid @agentId@. As of now, either @follower@ or @commenter@ is supported. If both params are given, @commenter@ will be ignored.

post.description: Updates a single field value across multiple tickets simultaneously.

get.description: Retrieves a list of tickets, with pagination support.

parameters.name: departmentIds
parameters.description: Departments from which the tickets need to be queried. _Note_ : @For Predefined Views@ and @All Department Views@: You must specify the departmentId for which the tickets need to be fetched. Otherwise, it will fetch all tickets accessible across departments. For @Single Department Custom View@: You must specify the departmentId of the department for which the Custom View was created. The tickets will be fetched from that department.

parameters.name: priority
parameters.description: Key that filters tickets by priority. Multiple priority levels can be passed as comma-separated values.

parameters.name: receivedInDays
parameters.description: Time period (in days) for fetching tickets based on customerResponseTime. Possible values: 15, 30, 90 days

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Status of the ticket Note: Multiple values can be provided by separating them with commas

parameters.name: viewId
parameters.description: ID of the view based on which tickets must be fetched

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Key that returns the values of mentioned fields (both pre-defined and custom) in your portal. All field types except multi-text are supported. Standard, non-editable fields are supported too. These fields include: @statusType@, @webUrl@, @layoutId@. Maximum of 30 fields is supported as comma separated values.

parameters.name: filters
parameters.description: Filters tickets based on the values of the selected fields. Maximum number of fields: 25
